notes: Needs overlap: a part's full marks are counted under EVERY need it has, so need totals exceed settings+no-fit. The 'settings' verdict for 16 calculation parts (64 marks) assumes steps gains two step kinds: a formula step (pick the correct formula) and a substitution step (number slots in the formula template); without that, these are no-fit, because the memo awards formula and substitution marks and penalises answer-only (2.3.1: 1/2; 7.3 'show that' gives the answer, so only working is marked). Mixing a formula pick inside steps is the catalogue's listed 'multi-part answer that mixes types' gap. Alternative solution paths (up to 6 options in 3.3, 5 in 5.4) and accepted RANGES (3.3, 8.4) also need steps to accept several step sequences. Cross-part positive marking (7 parts) is not in the catalogue: steps follow-through is within one part only. Method restrictions ('equations of motion only', 'energy principles only': 3.2, 3.3, 5.2, 5.4) cost marks if violated; a formula-pick step could enforce them. Scientific-notation entry on the num keypad is UNVERIFIED (catalogue does not say); flagged as a setting for 10.1.2 and 10.2.1. MCQ 1.2 and 1.10 have graph options: they work only as a composite figure with letter-only cards. All shared context (circuits, graphs, table, energy diagram) is covered by image/table support; no part needs a fill-in table. Every Choose-from + Explain part fits rubric, including 2.4 whose memo accepts all three choices with different reasoning.
